# Repository instructions for GitHub Copilot

Before modifying this repository, read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), [docs/V0_7_STATUS.md](../docs/V0_7_STATUS.md) and the relevant implementation files.

Key requirements: all repository content is English and beginner friendly; firmware remains native ESP-IDF and free of ESPHome runtime; there is one universal CC1101 RX/TX manager; secrets and local board overrides must never enter GitHub; source tests are not proof of a real ESP-IDF build or hardware validation. Never claim unfinished features or firmware are production ready.

Update documentation and implementation status alongside code changes. Include test evidence and clear limitations in your final summary.
